description: Kebun Kita — game survival pertanian & peternakan 3D multiplayer di browser (MVP)
name: kebun-kita

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@kebun-kita/shared && npm run build --workspace=server --if-present && npm run build --workspace=client --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@kebun-kita/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
